requirements.text: The operator keeps the same public deployment interface, manifest and mirror formats, node decisions and refusal messages. The table also requires a focused execution of the moved attach function, separate from the public verify command's script identity check.

evidence-and-authority.text: The diagram shows two library paths from a manifest: verification reads the live policy and windows, while attachment resolves outputs without those checks. A retained journey caller separately compares a loaded mirror with the chain. The accepted Lean tree governs registry behavior, while concrete file and node claims need their own evidence.
